23:00 │ EN VIVO AHORA: United States of Scandal
In a uniquely personal episode, Jake unpacks the Appalachian trail scandal of his friend and former South Carolina Governor Mark Sanford and explores the difference between the politician and the man underneath.

00:00 │ A CONTINUACIÓN: United States of Scandal
Jake has a candid conversation with Rielle Hunter, the "other woman" in the scandal around former Sen. John Edwards; what began as a tabloid rumor about a campaign affair and a love child snowballed to prime time news and a federal trial.

Canal CNN Internacional
